title: A Ledger for the Alibi
author: T. M. Eriksen
blurb: Gideon Sterling, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
